class.name: SkinTokensPipeline
class.brief_description: Loaded skin-tokens bundle, kept resident across [method rig_file] calls.
class.description: Holds the [code skip-lint]st_model[/code] handle so a batch of parts shares one loaded weight set instead of paying [code skip-lint]st_model_load[/code] per invocation. Compare with [method SkinTokensModel.rig_file], which loads and frees per call.

method.name: load
method.description: Load the skin-tokens bundle. Required key [code skip-lint]bundle_path[/code]. Optional keys: [code skip-lint]threads[/code], [code skip-lint]device[/code] (0 auto, 1 CPU, 2 Vulkan). Returns [code]true[/code] on success; on failure pushes the reason through [method @GlobalScope.printerr] and leaves the pipeline unloaded.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method load] has succeeded and [method unload] has not been called since.

method.name: backend
method.description: Returns the ggml backend the loaded pipeline is running on. Empty when not loaded.

method.name: last_error
method.description: Returns the loaded model's last error string, or empty when nothing has failed since load.

method.name: rig_file
method.description: Rig an unrigged GLB at [param mesh_path], writing the rigged GLB to [param output_path]. Reuses the loaded weights across calls, so a batch of parts pays [code skip-lint]st_model_load[/code] once. [param opts] optional keys: [code skip-lint]seed[/code], [code skip-lint]top_k[/code], [code skip-lint]top_p[/code], [code skip-lint]temperature[/code], [code skip-lint]repetition_penalty[/code], [code skip-lint]beams[/code], [code skip-lint]max_tokens[/code], [code skip-lint]geometric_only[/code]. Returns the [code skip-lint]st_status[/code] enum: 0 on success; any other value is a failure whose reason was pushed through [method @GlobalScope.printerr].

method.name: unload
method.description: Release the loaded pipeline. Safe to call more than once. The destructor also calls this.
